mapper.update: UPDATE t_sys_org SET t_sys_org.left_num = t_sys_org.left_num + 2 WHERE t_sys_org.delete_flag = 0 AND t_sys_org.left_num >= (SELECT a.right_num FROM (SELECT t_sys_org.right_num FROM t_sys_org WHERE t_sys_org.id = #{pid} AND t_sys_org.delete_flag = 0) a);

UPDATE t_sys_org SET t_sys_org.right_num = t_sys_org.right_num + 2 WHERE t_sys_org.delete_flag = 0 AND t_sys_org.right_num >= (SELECT a.right_num FROM (SELECT t_sys_org.right_num FROM t_sys_org WHERE t_sys_org.id = #{pid} AND t_sys_org.delete_flag = 0) a);

UPDATE t_sys_org SET t_sys_org.left_num = (-t_sys_org.left_num) + #{pRightNum} - #{leftNum}, t_sys_org.right_num= (-t_sys_org.right_num) + #{pRightNum} - #{leftNum}, t_sys_org.node_level= -t_sys_org.node_level where t_sys_org.left_num < 0 AND t_sys_org.delete_flag = 0 ;
mapper.select: SELECT children.* FROM t_sys_org, t_sys_org as children WHERE t_sys_org.left_num < children.left_num AND t_sys_org.right_num > children.left_num and t_sys_org.id = #{id} and t_sys_org.delete_flag = 0 order by t_sys_org.node_level ASC;

select t_sys_org.id, t_sys_org.pid, t_sys_org.name, t_sys_org.full_name, t_sys_org.icon, t_sys_org.node_level, t_sys_org.status, t_sys_org.org_type, t_sys_org.create_time, t_sys_org.update_time from t_sys_org LEFT JOIN t_org_user_relation on t_org_user_relation.org_id = t_sys_org.id where 1 = 1 AND t_org_user_relation.user_id = #{userId}
order by t_sys_org.node_level ASC

select t_sys_user.id, t_sys_user.org_id, t_sys_user.avatar, t_sys_user.name, t_sys_user.email, t_sys_user.sex, t_sys_user.createtime, t_sys_user.phone from t_sys_user LEFT JOIN t_org_user_relation on (t_org_user_relation.user_id = t_sys_user.id AND t_org_user_relation.is_leader = 1) where 1 = 1 AND t_org_user_relation.org_id = #{orgId}

select * from ( SELECT children.* FROM t_sys_org, t_sys_org as children WHERE t_sys_org.left_num <= children.left_num AND t_sys_org.right_num >= children.left_num order by t_sys_org.node_level ASC ) t_sys_org where t_sys_org.b_type = #{bType}
and (t_sys_org.`name` LIKE concat('%',#{search},'%') OR t_sys_org.full_name like concat('%',#{search},'%')) OR t_sys_org.org_code like concat('%',#{search},'%'))
select t_sys_org.* from t_sys_org WHERE t_sys_org.pid is null

select * from ( SELECT children.* FROM t_sys_org, t_sys_org as children WHERE t_sys_org.left_num <= children.left_num AND t_sys_org.right_num >= children.left_num and t_sys_org.id=#{orgId} order by t_sys_org.node_level ASC ) t_sys_org where t_sys_org.b_type = #{bType}
and (t_sys_org.`name` LIKE concat('%',#{search},'%') OR t_sys_org.full_name like concat('%',#{search},'%')) OR t_sys_org.org_code like concat('%',#{search},'%'))
